title: AI firm ElevenLabs to invest 'hundreds of millions of dollars' in India
key_facts: ElevenLabs co-founder Mati Staniszewski said it plans to invest 'hundreds of millions of dollars' in its India operations.
India is its biggest market outside the US; it is building a team of close to 100 people there by end of year.
It will train voice models on Indian languages from the ground up; it supports 14 Indian languages and is working to add 22 more.
General manager Karthik Rajaram said it has worked with 250 enterprises and sees 100 million annual AI-agent conversations across 14 Indian languages.
More than 25,000 developers and businesses use its API each month in India, up about 2.5 times over the past year.
About 700 Indian creators are in its voice programme.
quote_evidence: ElevenLabs co-founder Mati Staniszewski said that the company is planning to invest "hundreds of millions of dollars" in its India operations.
ElevenLabs currently supports 14 Indian languages and is working to add 22 more.
why_it_matters_hint: ElevenLabs commits hundreds of millions to India and a team of about 100.
